revision_pairs.detailed_description: On 2012-12-07T15:09:49Z, Somedifferentstuff removed the statement that the British Mandate also covered present-day Jordan from the Etymology section.
On 2014-02-12T14:38:24Z, Ronbarak replaced ‘Jordan’ with ‘Transjordan’ in the 1948 Arab–Israeli War section’s account of the occupation of Cisjordan.
On 2014-02-19T13:09:30Z, IRISZOOM corrected Prime Minister Salam Fayad’s surname to ‘Fayyad’ in the account of the 2007 Hamas takeover in Gaza.
